subtitle: Read-only runtime diagnostics and targeted tracing toolkit for Stranded Deep mod development.
description: Inspection-first diagnostics for Stranded Deep BepInEx development. It provides split-screen-aware runtime inspection, snapshots, diffs, reports, capability discovery and targeted opt-in tracing without intentionally modifying gameplay or save data.
features: Split-screen-aware player and target resolution for Player 1 and Player 2.
Inspectors for objects, physics, cameras, input, UI, interaction, saveables, storage, inventory, world state, construction and loaded plugins.
Semantic target picking with pin/unpin support for repeated inspection of the same runtime object.
Snapshot, diff and report export tools for comparing runtime state and preserving incident evidence.
Targeted opt-in Harmony tracing that can be enabled only when needed and is removed when disabled or when the world unloads.
Dedicated AUDIO diagnostics for discovery, DSP telemetry and focused incident tracing.
Dedicated RAFT diagnostics for runtime raft discovery, sampling and incident analysis.
Capability Manifest reports AVAILABLE, PARTIAL or UNAVAILABLE support instead of assuming every diagnostic path is present.
Optional BamEx adapters add project-specific knowledge for Boombox and Raft Furniture without making them core dependencies.
Inspection-first design: the tool does not intentionally modify gameplay, save data, Rigidbody state, placement validity, attachment state or collision-ignore state.

faq.question: Does Diagnostics modify my save or gameplay?
faq.answer: It is designed as an inspection-first tool. By default it reads runtime state and does not intentionally modify gameplay or save data. Targeted tracing is opt-in instrumentation rather than a gameplay feature.

faq.question: Does it support local split-screen?
faq.answer: Yes. Player 1 and Player 2 are resolved separately through the game player, player-camera and Rewired chains rather than treating Camera.main as player identity.

faq.question: What are the main hotkeys?
faq.answer: F8 toggles Diagnostics, Alt+F8 switches P1/P2, F9 changes module, F10 pins or unpins the target, F11 runs module-specific targeted tracing, F12 writes a report or incident snapshot, Shift+F12 runs diff/status actions, and Ctrl+F12 enables deeper safe-field inspection for OBJECT/PHYSICS.

faq.question: Where are reports written?
faq.answer: With the default portable configuration, reports are written under BepInEx/config/StrandedDeepDiagnostics/Reports.

faq.question: Are the BamEx adapters required?
faq.answer: No. The core diagnostics work without them. The BamEx adapters are optional extensions for project-specific Boombox and Raft Furniture inspection.

faq.question: Why is this version marked as a pre-release?
faq.answer: v1.0.0-rc1 is the first public release candidate. It is distributed through the common Stranded Deep mod catalog and Mod Manager while remaining explicitly marked as a pre-release.
